statement: Lambda lists on-demand NVIDIA B200 SXM6 at $6.69 per GPU-hour for 8-GPU instances
why: A published rental level for current-generation capacity, with no prior price shown to compare against.

impact.mechanism: Sets a public reference rate for renting current-generation accelerators; static level with no stated baseline, so no direction can be read.

confidence.basis: Vendor pricing page but no as-of date shown; document date is the fetch date.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 2.79 -> 6.69 (tol 1%); sources: Lambda Labs
